mapper.sql: a.id, a.task_id, a.student_id, a.answer_json, a.answer_count, a.total_items, a.score_total, a.score_band, a.duration_seconds, a.submitted_at, a.created_at, a.updated_at, a.deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO psyche_answer (task_id, student_id, answer_json, answer_count, total_items, score_total, score_band, duration_seconds, submitted_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{studentId}, #{answerJson}, #{answerCount}, #{totalItems}, #{scoreTotal}, #{scoreBand}, #{durationSeconds}, #{submittedAt}, NOW(), NOW(), 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE student_id = #{studentId}, answer_json = #{answerJson}, answer_count = #{answerCount}, total_items = #{totalItems}, score_total = #{scoreTotal}, score_band = #{scoreBand}, duration_seconds = #{durationSeconds}, submitted_at = #{submittedAt}, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT FROM psyche_answer a WHERE a.task_id = #{taskId} AND a.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
